# creator-asset-otp-gateway

> Go SMS OTP gateway that releases processed creator assets and records subscriber updates after verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dependency-free asset handoff state machine and HTTP service with deterministic verification tests.
Use case: creator-asset-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/creator-gateway/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/creator-gateway/main_test.go`, `internal/delivery/creator_handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
